title: Hyper Warfare
description:
Hyper Warfare is an intense multiplayer team-based first-person shooter, delivering fast-paced combat, responsive gunplay, and competitive action.

Jump into battle with your squad, choose your loadout, and dominate the battlefield in dynamic matches where every second counts. Whether you prefer close-range aggression or long-distance precision, Hyper Warfare offers multiple playstyles to match your strategy.

Engage in thrilling matches where two teams spawn at separate locations and fight for dominance. Even when players are missing, intelligent bots ensure that matches stay full and action-packed.

Select your weapons, and prove your skills in non-stop combat.
description_short: Fast-paced multiplayer team-based FPS where skill, strategy, and reflexes decide victory.
